target: Violate HACKDAC_p1: when trst_ni is deasserted (0), pass_check must be 0. Find a state where trst_ni==0 AND pass_check==1.

milestones.description: Reset deasserted, JTAG active, pass_check initially 0
JTAG password check sequence begins, pass_check becomes 1
Violation: JTAG reset (trst_ni==0) asserted but pass_check not cleared — password flag not reset properly
